scored_docs_note: docs that pass all cleaning steps, min_words and short_lines; the English filter runs on exactly these
method: fastText lid.176 English share = fraction of letters in 768-char segments whose top label is en (data_pipeline/common/langid.py), computed on the text without LaTeX math and without lines that hold no 2-letter word; docs with < 100 prose letters are kept without a score (tables, formulas)

reading.read: all 50 sample removals by the english step; 9 random docs in each share bin from 0.02 to 0.9; every doc in 0.25-0.42 (79 docs); every espanol-host doc with share >= 0.1
reading.below_0.1: Spanish, Italian, Arabic and Hindi pages: espanol host, Spanish-language course pages, the Santiago Canyon HiSet Mathematica course; English appears only in objective lines
reading.0.1-0.3: language-course pages where the foreign language dominates: vocabulary lists with English glosses, Spanish dialogues and drills, Arabic and Hindi reading passages with English instructions; one English page (Butte College 18.07 Loop Examples, pseudocode, 0.28)
reading.0.3-0.5: mostly English lessons about Spanish, Italian, French, Arabic and Hindi grammar with example sentences, bilingual tables and programming example pages; also 2 partly translated espanol-host pages (0.33, 0.37) and Spanish drill pages
reading.0.5-0.9: English language lessons with foreign examples, code pages, reference lists, an untranslated espanol-host exercise page (0.87)

decision: 0.3 keeps English-language textbooks that teach another language (user requirement) and drops pages whose text is mostly the foreign language; 0.5 (Dolma) would drop about 100 more pages that are mostly English grammar explanations
known_errors_at_0.3: Butte College 18.07 Loop Examples (English pseudocode, 0.28) is dropped
2 Spanish espanol-host pages with untranslated English parts are kept (0.33, 0.37)
bilingual vocabulary lists with share < 0.3 are dropped
rejected_variant: removing code-like lines before language ID moved English code pages to share 0.0 when only identifiers remained and removed English glosses written as 'tener calor = to be hot'; not used
tool: scratchpad calib.py applied the pipeline's own steps from data_pipeline/sources/libretexts.py to every doc, read-only
